correctness.rationale: The homogeneous cone presentation gives the ordinary associated graded ring before completion; the six free directions and two factors then multiply Hilbert series. An independent exact calculation (python3 /workspace/review_checks.py 3) used lex order with reversed variable order, 18 initial generators, and monomial colon recursion, recovering the stated numerator and full hull coefficients. Independently, Newton identities turn the degree 1–4 power sums into equality of the padded four-element multisets for each relation family. The resulting linear kernels all lie in the stated line or three-space (49 distinct matching pairs tested by exact row reduction), and both spaces annihilate the ideal. Thus the reduced Hilbert series is the sum for the two spaces minus their origin, and graded subtraction gives the stated nilradical series. Completion preserves these associated gradeds and the completed reduced linear union is reduced. This calculation does not concern the automorphism-invariant coarse moduli ring.
residual_risks: Geometric identification with the qG hull uses the cited primary presentation; the algebra check starts from that presentation.
